subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support allow `updateConfiguration` and explicit preview-field pass-through, and should the new setting be top-level, per-account, default-on, or explicit opt-in?
rationale: The implementation surface is clear, but default behavior, linked-device failure mode, and untrusted metadata boundaries are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in support
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that preserves current behavior when unset, passes only caller-provided preview fields, and documents primary-device limits before enabling configuration updates.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the link-preview metadata boundary, then implement Signal config with that policy.

options.title: Default-on support
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default while preserving an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in support
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that preserves current behavior when unset, passes only caller-provided preview fields, and documents primary-device limits before enabling configuration updates.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already provided relevant public Signal implementation context on this issue.
